description: This file defines classes and templates related to frame serialization, including fixed-size integer types, a generic frame buffer with read/write capabilities, and methods for encoding/decoding various data types with support for endianness and variable-length encoding. It appears to be part of a core serialization or framing library within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: SInt24
classes.description: A class representing a 24-bit signed integer with serialization support.

classes.name: UInt24
classes.description: A class representing a 24-bit unsigned integer with serialization support.

classes.name: FrameType
classes.description: A template class implementing a flexible frame buffer with read/write capabilities, supporting variable-length encoding, endianness, and dynamic resizing.

methods.name: RealSize
methods.description: Template functions to determine the real size of a type or class, considering custom SizeOf static member.
